partial.label: Partial
partial.desc: Some calls work, many apps still fail

missing.label: Missing
missing.desc: Not implemented yet: this is where help is needed

blocked.label: Blocked by design
blocked.desc: Cannot be done honestly without Google's certification

features.name: RCS messaging
features.note: Rich chat in Google Messages. Open bounty of $14,999, the largest on the tracker.

features.name: Push notifications (FCM)
features.note: Firebase Cloud Messaging works. A UnifiedPush bridge is being discussed.

features.name: Wear OS & watch companions
features.note: Wearable API is mostly missing, so watch companion apps don't sync. Open bounty $2,340.

features.name: Android Auto
features.note: Not implemented. The wiki notes it may work when the official Android Auto app is installed as a privileged app.

features.name: Nearby / Quick Share
features.note: Nearby connections and Quick Share (formerly Nearby Share) are not implemented.

features.name: Google Cast
features.note: Listed as partial in the wiki. A full implementation is in review and casts YouTube end to end on real Chromecasts.
features.progress: In review: microg/GmsCore#3845 (+ fixes in woahwhattheheck/GmsCore#16)

features.name: Find My Device network
features.note: Participation in Google's crowd-sourced Find My Device network (trackers, offline finding).

features.name: Matter smart-home setup
features.note: The Matter device commissioning flow apps use to add smart-home devices.

features.name: Fitness
features.note: Only placeholder services so apps don't crash.

features.name: Passkeys & FIDO2
features.note: FIDO2/U2F security keys work over USB and NFC. Passkeys (synced credentials) are the remaining gap.

features.name: Google Pay / Wallet
features.note: Payments and Wallet are not implemented. Contactless payment also depends on strong device attestation.

features.name: Play Integrity (basic)
features.note: Basic integrity checks and SafetyNet work for many apps.

features.name: Play Integrity (device / strong)
features.note: Device and strong verdicts attest a Google-certified, locked device. Apps that require them (many banks, Wallet) reject de-Googled phones by design. This needs pressure on app makers and regulators, not code.

features.name: Google account sign-in
features.note: Account login works; the wiki lists it as partial because of past regressions and edge cases.

features.name: Smart Lock / password save
features.note: Smart Lock for Passwords and related credential APIs.

features.name: Firebase Auth
features.note: Anonymous, email/password, phone and custom-token login work. Google Sign-In and FirebaseUI do not.

features.name: Play Games
features.note: Some games services work. The official Play Games app does not.

features.name: ARCore
features.note: Augmented reality services.

features.name: Vision / barcode
features.note: Only barcode scanning is implemented.

features.name: Face detection
features.note: Partly implemented.

features.name: Downloadable fonts
features.note: Listed as not implemented in the wiki; the tracking issue was closed in 2026, check for updates.

features.name: Fused location
features.note: Works. Mozilla Location Service retired, see the linked discussions for how network location works now.

features.name: Maps API v2
features.note: The Mapbox-based build works for most apps with minor glitches. The VTM build lacks many APIs.

features.name: Geofencing
features.note: Not implemented.

features.name: In-app updates
features.note: Only a placeholder service so apps don't crash.

features.name: Play asset delivery
features.note: Mostly works.

features.name: Split install
features.note: Partly implemented, some apps crash.

features.name: SMS retriever
features.note: Mostly works (automatic SMS code entry).

features.name: Drive API
features.note: Implemented.

features.name: Ads & analytics
features.note: Mobile ads, Analytics and Firebase Analytics are left out on purpose.
